+def purge_expired_keys(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, now: datetime) -> int:

+    with write_txn(conn):
+        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM idempotency_keys WHERE created_at < ?", (oldest,))
+        return cur.rowcount
